sticker_location: Inside the fridge on the left wall, near the top or behind the crisper drawer.

problems.title: Not cold enough
symptoms: My fridge is warm but the freezer is cold

plan.diagnosis: The coils under the fridge get blanketed in dust, so it can't shed heat and runs warm. Blocked air vents inside do the same. Cleaning the coils and clearing the vents usually brings the cold back in a few hours.
safety: Unplug the fridge before you reach under it; the fan there can spin up.

steps.instruction: Unplug the fridge
details: Pull the plug, not the cord.
Food is fine for an hour with the doors shut.
steps.check: The inside light stays off when you open the door.

steps.instruction: Pull off the grille at the bottom front
details: It clips on; pull gently at both ends.
steps.check: The grille is off and you can see under the fridge.

steps.instruction: Vacuum the dust off the coils
details: Use the brush tool and go slowly.
A flashlight helps you see to the back.
steps.check: The coils look black, not gray and fuzzy.

steps.instruction: Clear the air vents in the freezer
details: Move food back from the slots; air has to flow down to the fridge.
steps.check: Nothing blocks the slots on the back wall.

steps.instruction: Set the dial to the middle
steps.check: The dial points at 3 to 4, or the middle mark.

steps.instruction: Grille back on, plug it in, wait 4 hours
details: A glass of water on the middle shelf should read 37 to 40°F.
steps.check: The fridge hums and feels cold after a few hours.

plan.diagnosis: With clean coils, the door seal is the next most likely cause: a gap lets warm air in all day. Cleaning the rubber and checking it grips fixes most of them.

steps.instruction: Close the door on a dollar bill
details: Try the top, sides and bottom.
If it slides out easily, the seal isn't gripping there.
steps.check: You feel the bill drag when you pull it out.

steps.instruction: Wipe the seal with warm soapy water
details: Sticky spills stop it sealing.
Dry it after.
steps.check: The rubber is clean and not sticky.

steps.instruction: Close the door and test again
details: A torn or flat seal can be replaced; search your model number + door gasket.
steps.check: The bill drags everywhere you test.

problems.title: Water in the bottom
symptoms: There's water in the bottom of the fridge
Ice on the back wall of the fridge

plan.diagnosis: The small drain at the back of the fridge is blocked with ice or crumbs, so defrost water pools instead of draining away. Clearing it with warm water fixes it.

steps.instruction: Open the fridge and take out the bottom drawers
steps.check: You can see the back wall at the bottom.

steps.instruction: Soak up the water
details: Use a towel or sponge.
steps.check: The floor of the fridge is dry.

steps.instruction: Find the drain hole on the back wall
details: It's low on the back wall, sometimes under a cover.
steps.check: You can see the small hole or channel.

steps.instruction: Push warm water into the drain
details: Use a turkey baster or a squeeze bottle.
A pipe cleaner loosens stuck crumbs.
steps.check: Water goes down the hole instead of pooling.

steps.instruction: Put the drawers back and close the door
steps.check: The bottom stays dry over the next day.

problems.title: Water tastes bad or flows slow
symptoms: The water from the fridge tastes bad
I need to change the fridge water filter

plan.diagnosis: The water filter clogs after about six months, so water slows down and tastes off. Swapping it takes two minutes.
replacement_parts: Water filter for your fridge (match the old one's number)

steps.instruction: Open the fridge and find the filter
details: It's usually in the top right corner, or in the grille at the bottom.
steps.check: You can see the filter cap.

steps.instruction: Twist the old filter a quarter turn and pull
details: A little water drips out; have a towel ready.
steps.check: The old filter is out.

steps.instruction: Push the new filter in and twist to lock
details: Take the cap off the new one first.
Match the model number on the old filter.
steps.check: It clicks and the cap lines up.

steps.instruction: Run 2 gallons through the dispenser
details: The first water can be cloudy or sputter; that's air.
Hold the filter reset button for 3 seconds if it has one.
steps.check: Water runs clear and steady.

problems.title: Freezing my food
symptoms: The fridge is freezing my food
Everything in the fridge is frozen

plan.diagnosis: The dial is set too cold, or food is blocking the cold air coming down from the freezer onto it. Turning the dial warmer and moving food fixes it within a day.

steps.instruction: Turn the dial one step warmer
details: On most fridges, a lower number is warmer.
steps.check: The dial is one number lower (warmer).

steps.instruction: Move food away from the top back
details: Cold air pours in at the top back.
steps.check: Nothing sits right under the cold air slot.

steps.instruction: Check again tomorrow
details: 37 to 40°F is right for a fridge.
steps.check: Food stays cold but doesn't freeze.
